description:

You can see a closed fridge. What's that over there? It looks like it's an oven. As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a table. Does this look like anything mentioned in the instructions? On the table you see a cookbook. It doesn't get more TextWorld than this! You make out a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you make out a red apple. Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.
